integrity: The all-integer proof is structural and uses combinatorial Alexander duality; a bundled standard-library checker verifies four finite instances without claiming independent review.
scientific_limitations: Proved the nonequivariant homotopy type only of the combinatorial Alexander dual and reduced integral homology of the original ordinary three-cut complex; no original cut-complex homotopy type or other cut parameters. Unindexed prior work remains a risk.
title: Three-cut homology of triangular graphs and a dual sphere-wedge theorem
